identity.title: Consolidate new-recipe identity, source, and task setup

origin.summary: The first recipe required separate Recipe Center, Save As, source-open, and tool-selection contexts before teaching could begin, and the owned system dialog exceeded the compact parent bounds.

state.current_summary: PL-0013 is complete: one visible first-use setup owns recipe identity, folder, C3D source, optional compatible starter, confirmed remembered restore, stale validation, and Reset without implicit execution.

objective.summary: Let an operator establish recipe identity, file location, source, and an optional compatible task starter in one coherent first-use setup while retaining explicit Create and execution boundaries.
constraints: Restoring prior values must not create, load, add, Preview, Publish, or Run by itself.
Persist values at project or workspace scope only after explicit confirmation.
Keep restored values visible, editable, validated, and resettable.
Keep owned dialogs inside supported Wide and Compact monitor/window bounds.

criteria.text: One first-use surface exposes recipe name, recipe folder, source, and optional task starter before an explicit Create action.
Confirmed workspace-scoped setup survives save/reload/reopen, stale paths are explained, and Reset returns to safe defaults without side effects.
Wide and Compact owned dialogs remain visible, keyboard reachable, and on the selected application monitor.

context.summary: The observed first-use route created 01-filter-thickness through separate save and source dialogs before step setup.

evidence.observation: Recipe Manager + WPG passed 49/49, Tool Recipe teaching 46/46, Workbench docking 84/84, Shell smoke options 39/39, and final Debug/Release builds had zero warnings and zero errors. Checks cover the four setup inputs, exact target, no-action draft/restore/reset, remembered save/reopen, stale-path explanation, disabled Create, and localized copy.

evidence.kind: current Release EXE lifecycle and UI verification
evidence.observation: Actual Release EXE empty and Thickness setup both saved and reopened; Thickness retained one typed step from source.c3d.height-map with matching Viewer source and clean state. Current Wide/Compact English/Korean valid, focus, popup, stale/disabled, and held pressed captures remained themed and bounded on dynamically selected leftmost DISPLAY2. Refreshed Wide/Compact R0 ValidateOnly passed all fixed hashes and launched no application.

events.summary: PL-0013 implementation is in progress: the existing Recipe Center, FirstRecipeUx owner, C3D loader, typed Add boundary, and recent-recipe configuration location will be reused for one explicit first-use setup without automatic execution.

All PL-0013 criteria are proved by focused no-action and persistence checks, actual Release EXE empty/Thickness save-reopen, localized Wide/Compact UI states, and refreshed fixed-package validation; PL-0012 is next and owner R0 remains external.
